prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a Chinese-first community tutorial submission banner for a GitHub research tools library, wide landscape approximately 2.5:1. Match warm ivory paper texture, deep navy Chinese headline, cobalt blue call-to-action, pale watercolor cyan, beautifully crafted paper collage and spacious editorial layout. Left 58%: exceptionally legible large Chinese invitation. Right 42%: paper-collage scene of someone sharing practical research knowledge: a neat open notebook with numbered step markers (no readable body text), a simple video card with a play triangle, an editable chart card and a pencil, with a hand gently offering a tutorial booklet to the collection. Friendly, useful, polished, visually consistent with a blue research toolbox community banner.
Exact text only:
small eyebrow "科研实用教程征集"
large headline on two lines "把科研经验，" then "写成一篇好教程。"
medium subtitle "图文 · 视频 · 代码笔记 · 实操记录"
bold rounded blue call-to-action label "分享教程 / 推荐好教程"
small footer "skill.createsci.com"
All Chinese characters must be correct, bold headline clearly readable at 850px width, generous margins, no clutter. The banner will link to an actual tutorial submission form. Do not imply submitted tutorials have already been verified or published. No payment or reward claims, deadlines, badges, QR codes, robots, third-party logos, actual data or product screenshots, English branding headlines, gibberish text, watermark. Preserve a calm research publication look.
